bom_audit.summary: Facts-only audit. BOM manages 11 qqq modules via ${revision}. Gaps: 5 internal modules missing; 20 QBits + qbit-build-parent + qctl + frontend version properties not managed. Version drift: 4 different qbit-build-parent versions across QBits (1.1.0/1.4.0/1.5.1/1.6.0). qqq-app-starter pinned to qqq-bom 0.24.0-SNAPSHOT (~18 versions stale). Template QBits pin qqq.version=0.35.0 directly. qbit-worm-audit is an uncustomized duplicate of qbit-template-extension. Four groupIds span the ecosystem. ${revision} is reactor-scoped — can't cross repos.

critical_anti_patterns.pattern: Spawning general-purpose agents with prompts that trigger skill auto-invocation
critical_anti_patterns.description: First BOM-audit spawn (agent a33c54037a25a945b) returned with an unrelated 'needs Bash + Read on ~/.claude/projects/' ask — looked like the fewer-permission-prompts skill auto-fired instead of executing the actual task prompt. Resolved by doing the audit inline with direct tool calls.
critical_anti_patterns.prevention: For finite file-reading work, prefer inline tool calls over general-purpose agent spawns. If spawning, be explicit that the agent should perform ONLY the task in the prompt and not invoke any skills.

critical_anti_patterns.pattern: Meridian-family subagent_type without explicit model parameter
critical_anti_patterns.description: First research agent spawn with subagent_type=researcher failed with 'gpt-5.4-mini not available' — meridian-family agents default to a different model family. Resolved by using subagent_type=general-purpose with explicit model=sonnet.
critical_anti_patterns.prevention: For external web research, use subagent_type=general-purpose with model=sonnet explicitly; do not use meridian-family agents (researcher, brainstormer, etc.) in non-meridian projects.
